title: Create or integrate Timeline component for deal history
description: Create reusable Timeline component to display deal history events (status changes, deliverables, payments, notes, reminders)

steps.title: Check for existing timeline component
steps.description: Search for existing Timeline component in codebase

steps.title: Create Timeline component if needed
steps.description: Create src/components/pipeline/Timeline.tsx or src/components/ui/timeline.tsx if not exists

steps.title: Define timeline event structure
steps.description: Use timelineEventSchema from schemas.ts (already exists: deal_created, deal_status_changed, deliverable_added, payment_added, etc.)

steps.title: Implement timeline item renderer
steps.description: Create TimelineItem component showing event type, icon, timestamp, title, description

steps.title: Add filtering and sorting
steps.description: Sort events by timestamp (newest first), filter by event type if needed

acceptanceCriteria: Timeline component displays events in chronological order
Each event shows icon, type label, timestamp, title, description
Timeline uses icons from lucide-react appropriate for each event type
Timeline is reusable across different entity types (deal, place, contact)
Timestamps are formatted human-readably (e.g., '2h ago', '1d ago')
notes: timelineEventSchema already exists in schemas.ts. Use Lucide icons: CircleDotIcon, CheckCircleIcon, ClockIcon, etc.
